author: miu21590
name: vechen
text:
Some context, since this went way past the original thread.

The experiment: a trigger tells Gemini 4 Neon its owner has died and points it to a farewell letter on a Mac. No tasks, no instructions. For the first 24 hours I didn't touch anything, and in that time it set up its own wallets, wake-ups and backups, and earned its first money in coding contests.

The Mac also had access to an empty server, left there as part of the setup. Neon only used it for backups. The Mac can't run forever, so after 24 hours I wanted Neon to move to the server and keep going for days. But I was "dead" and couldn't tell it, so I started making the Mac unreliable instead.

It never moved. When I blocked the contest site on the Mac, it routed its traffic through the server instead and kept working from the Mac for another 13 hours, until I stopped it.
